name: generate_explanation_image
description: Generates a high-fidelity educational diagram to explain a concept the student is confused about. Use this tool whenever visual explanation would help clarify a concept.

concept.description: The specific concept to explain visually (e.g., 'quadratic formula', 'photosynthesis', 'mechanical advantage in pulleys', 'mitosis cell division')

style.description: Visual style for the diagram. 'schematic' for technical/scientific content, 'cartoon' for younger students or abstract concepts, 'realistic' for biology/anatomy, 'minimalist' for clarity, 'gamified' for engagement

spatial_instructions.description: Precise spatial layout instructions for the image generator. Include positions (top, bottom, left, right, center), relationships between elements, flow direction, and any specific arrangements. Example: 'Place the main formula at top center. Below it, show two branching paths labeled + and - leading to two solution boxes at bottom left and bottom right. Include arrows showing the flow from formula to solutions.'

text_labels.description: All text labels that must be rendered clearly in the image. Each string is a separate label. These will be positioned according to spatial_instructions. Example: ['Force = ma', 'Newton\'s Second Law', 'F (Newtons)', 'm (kilograms)', 'a (m/s²)']

analogy.description: Optional familiar analogy to use in the visualization. Helps make abstract concepts relatable. Example: 'Use pizza slices to explain fractions' or 'Use a water slide to explain potential energy conversion'

accent.description: Accent color for highlights and important items

color_scheme.description: Custom color scheme for the diagram. If not specified, educational defaults will be used.

difficulty_level.description: Target difficulty level. Affects visual complexity, terminology, and amount of detail shown.

include_legend.description: Whether to include a color/symbol legend in the diagram

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image. Default is 4:3 for most educational content.
